 Former “Good Morning America” anchors Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes married in a private Arkansas ceremony in September, four years after their relationship became public.
 In 2022, the paparazzi leaked photos of the two holding hands, nestled into each other at a New York bar, and Holmes patting Robach on the rear.
 p]:text-cms-story-body-color-text" data-subscriber-content> Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes finally ran off and made the thing official. 
 The former “Good Morning America” anchors tied the knot in a private Arkansas ceremony back in September. The marriage license, obtained by People , confirmed the Washington County nuptials. 
 Last October, the couple announced their engagement on the “Amy & T.J.” podcast . “We’re actually surprised we’re just now talking about it,” Holmes said. “We wanted to let you all know before anybody was able to. We learned that lesson I guess in the past about our relationship: We want to be the first to talk about it.”
 The lesson Holmes is referencing is the couple’s big relationship reveal , which happened while they were both anchors on “GMA3” and married to other people. 
 Advertisement In 2022, the paparazzi leaked photos of the two holding hands, nestled into each other at a New York bar, and Holmes patting Robach on the rear. Chaos broke loose in the media and behind the scenes at ABC. Holmes’ then-wife, attorney Marilee Fiebig, filed for divorce shortly thereafter, followed by the divorce of Robach and her second husband, “Melrose Place” actor Andrew Shue, months later. 
 The same month that news of the scandal broke, ABC parted ways with the anchors, and they deactivated their social media accounts. A year later, the broadcasting duo embraced their coupledom, naysayers be damned, and teamed up with iHeartPodcasts to launch “ Amy & T.J. ,” marketed as “informative, entertaining, and above all, authentic; it will mark the first time Robach and Holmes speak publicly since their own names became a part of the headlines.” 
 In the debut episode , Robach and Holmes detailed how the scandal unfolded and insisted they’d been quietly separated from their spouses before their love affair began. Both said that the scandal dominating the headlines and the loss of their dream jobs sent them into the depths of despair. 
 Advertisement “But we have had each other through it all,” Robach said. “It has been the most beautiful relationship I have had in my life.”
